ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel dominance on the visible upper surface, transitioning to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels at the proximal water line and within localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-pigmented field across the superior 80% of both lobes. High-intensity white banding is localized at the inferior margin where it meets the water. Discrete, high-contrast white circular micro-blobs are distributed across the dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated acute angle of approximately 65 degrees, showing a clean pixel-boundary separation between lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the continuous boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from 3-8 pixels, creating a jagged profile against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the terminal tips, transitioning into a linear-to-concave slope as the contour approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white rings) across the majority of the dark-pigmented surface, showing highest density on the distal third of the left lobe and middle section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive permanent scarring from barnacle colonization, manifesting as white circular rosette clusters varying in diameter across both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, high-contrast 'leopard-spot' pattern of white circular scars against a near-uniform black background.
